title: Pre-sleep wind-down routine
summary: Five-minute pre-sleep decompression after short sleep or slower reaction scores.

steps.text: Dim cabin displays and stow non-essential checklists before sleep.
Fasten your sleep restraint gently so every muscle can relax.
Breathe steadily: 4 seconds in, 6 seconds out for 3 minutes.
Protect a full 8.5-hour scheduled sleep period tonight.
